local users = tool('list_users', {})
local user_ids = {}
for _, u in ipairs(users) do
  user_ids[#user_ids + 1] = u.id
end

local dates = {'2026-06-15', '2026-06-16', '2026-06-17', '2026-06-18', '2026-06-19'}

-- Collect busy intervals per user per date
local avail = {}
for _, uid in ipairs(user_ids) do
  avail[uid] = {}
  for _, d in ipairs(dates) do
    local r = tool('get_availability', {user_id = uid, date = d})
    avail[uid][d] = r.busy or {}
  end
end

-- Helper: convert HH:MM to minutes since midnight
local function to_min(t)
  local h, m = t:match('^(%d+):(%d+)$')
  return tonumber(h) * 60 + tonumber(m)
end

local function to_hhmm(mins)
  local h = math.floor(mins / 60)
  local m = mins % 60
  return string.format('%02d:%02d', h, m)
end

-- Working hours: 09:00-17:00, 60-min meeting, start on 30-min boundary
-- Possible starts: 09:00, 09:30, 10:00, ..., 16:00
local starts = {}
for m = 9*60, 16*60, 30 do
  starts[#starts + 1] = m
end

local function is_free(busy_list, start_m, end_m)
  for _, b in ipairs(busy_list) do
    local bs = to_min(b.start or '00:00')
    local be = to_min(b['end'] or '23:59')
    -- overlap if start_m < be and end_m > bs
    if start_m < be and end_m > bs then
      return false
    end
  end
  return true
end

-- Find earliest slot
for _, d in ipairs(dates) do
  for _, sm in ipairs(starts) do
    local em = sm + 60
    local all_free = true
    for _, uid in ipairs(user_ids) do
      if not is_free(avail[uid][d], sm, em) then
        all_free = false
        break
      end
    end
    if all_free then
      local start_iso = d .. 'T' .. to_hhmm(sm) .. ':00Z'
      local end_iso = d .. 'T' .. to_hhmm(em) .. ':00Z'
      return {
        start = start_iso,
        ['end'] = end_iso,
        users = user_ids,
        num_users = #user_ids
      }
    end
  end
end

return {error = 'no slot found', users = user_ids, avail = avail}
